top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature, precisely bounded mechanism central to cellular proteostasis, with focused complementary attribution to Horwich and Hartl. Its citation can remain confined to chaperonin-assisted folding, avoiding the less settled credit boundaries in the leading translational alternatives.
recusal_note: My profile records collaborations in single-cell and spatial-transcriptomics research, but identifies no documented connection to the proposed P001 laureates or to another shortlisted candidate; none apparent from the supplied evidence.
